subject.title: fix(ui): new worktree sessions stay in Coding during creation

question: Should the temporary prepared-work-session state be accepted as the Control UI’s canonical way to preserve Coding placement and selected-model visibility until Gateway session metadata arrives?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proof-positive, but it changes session lifecycle state and carries the protected `maintainer` label, so an explicit owner decision is required before landing.

options.title: Accept the bounded bridge
options.body: Rebase the branch, retain the prepared-state cleanup behavior, and merge after the focused checks and real-Gateway proof still match the refreshed head.

options.title: Request a different lifecycle boundary
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want optimistic placement owned by a different session-state layer rather than the existing session capability.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded bridge
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, retain the prepared-state cleanup behavior, and merge after the focused checks and real-Gateway proof still match the refreshed head.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit trail connects steipete to both the prepared-state implementation and its focused regression coverage.
